This unit closed the gap between the routing arm and the capability manifest: (1) authored scripts/generate-wedm-capability-manifest.mjs to deterministically scan src/engines/ and emit a fresh manifest (137 engines across 23 categories, up from the prior stale 82-engine hand-maintained list), (2) bumped manifest schemaVersion → 2 and added autobridge_route block declaring process_match + engine + required/optional inputs + produces, (3) added getWedmCapabilityManifest() + canRouteWireEdm() methods to AutoPrintToProgramBridgeEngine with lazy load + cache, (4) added 13-test integration suite (AutoPrintToProgramBridgeEngine.wedmManifest.test.ts) verifying: schemaVersion≥2, primary_pipeline = WireEDMAIPrintToProgramEngine, total_engines≥95 (exit criterion), every listed engine has a real .ts file on disk, every entry has inputs+outputs, feature_types covers all 8 AutoBridge detector labels, autobridge_route shape matches code, caching returns same reference, canRouteWireEdm true, wire_edm process_type routes to one of 3 valid end states. 13/13 new tests pass in 38ms. Existing AutoBridge suite (25 tests) still green — 38/38 across both files.

Existing 8 WEDMConsultAwarenessWiring + 25 AutoBridge + 7 verifier + 13 manifest = 53 regression tests remain green. tsc clean on both edited files.
